{{TOC|side}}
This page lists [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]] controls based on pressed (or not) modifiers.

{{Feature|informative|A modifier is a key that changes another key behaviour when pressed in a combination; in Eden Editor such keys are {{Controls|Ctrl}}, {{Controls|Shift}} and/or {{Controls|Alt}}.}}

{{Clear}}
== No Modifier ==

Actions performed after pressing the given key directly, without modifier.

{{Keyboard

|Escape = Exit
|F1 = [[Eden Editor: Object|Objects]]
|F2 = [[Eden Editor: Group|Groups]]
|F3 = [[Eden Editor: Trigger|Triggers]]
|F4 = [[Eden Editor: Waypoint|Waypoints]]
|F5 = [[Eden Editor: System|Systems]]
|F6 = [[Eden Editor: Marker|Markers]]

|Tilde = [[Arma 3: Debug Console|Debug Console]]
|Key1 = [[Eden Editor: Transformation Widget|No Widget]]
|Key2 = [[Eden Editor: Transformation Widget#Translation Widget|Translation Widget]]
|Key3 = [[Eden Editor: Transformation Widget#Rotation Widget|Rotation Widget]]
|Key4 = [[Eden Editor: Transformation Widget#Area Scaling Widget|Scaling Widget]]
|Key5 = [[Eden Editor: Transformation Widget#Area Widget|Area Widget]]

|Tab = Toggle [[Eden Editor: Asset Browser|Submode]]
|Q = Cam Up
|W = Cam Forward
|E = Toggle [[Eden Editor: Asset Browser|Asset Browser]]
|R = Toggle Entity List
|LBracket = Decrease Grid Size
|RBracket = Increase Grid Size
|Backslash = Toggle [[Eden Editor: Entity Transforming|Surface Snap]]

|A = Cam Left
|S = Cam Back
|D = Cam Right
|F = Center on Entity
|L = Toggle Flashlight
|Semicolon = Toggle Grid
|Apostrophe = Toggle [[Eden Editor: Entity Transforming|Vertical Mode]]
|Enter = [[Eden Editor: Preview|Preview]] Scenario

|LShift = [[Eden Editor: Entity Transforming|Rotation]] Modifier
|Z = Cam Down
|N = Toggle Vision Mode
|M = Toggle Map
|Slash = Toggle [[Eden Editor: Waypoint|Waypoint Snap]]

|LCtrl = Selection Modifier
|LAlt = [[Eden Editor: Entity Transforming|Altitude]] Modifier
|Space = Toggle [[Eden Editor: Transformation Widget|Widget]]

|Delete = Delete Entity
|Home = Center on Player

|NumEnter = [[Eden Editor: Preview|Preview]] Scenario

== Ctrl Modifier ==

Actions performed after pressing the given key while holding Ctrl ({{Controls|Ctrl|<Key>}})

{{Keyboard

|R = Center on Random Position
|T = Toggle Map Textures
|Y = Redo
|O = Open Scenario

|A = Select All on Screen
|S = Save Scenario
|F = Search in Asset Browser
|G = Toggle Vegetation
|K = Open Preferences

|Z = Undo
|X = Cut Entities
|C = Copy Entities
|V = Paste Entities
|N = New Scenario
|M = Merge Scenarios


|colorR = PaleGreen
|colorT = PaleGreen
|colorY = PaleGreen
|colorO = PaleGreen

== Ctrl+Shift Modifier ==

Actions performed after pressing the given key while holding Ctrl and Shift ({{Controls|Ctrl|Shift|<Key>}})

{{Keyboard

|F = Search in entities
|S = Save As
|V = {{Link|Eden Editor: Actions#PasteUnitOrig|Raw-paste entities}}
|Enter = [[Eden Editor: Preview#Singleplayer at Camera Position|Preview from camera position]]
|NumEnter = [[Eden Editor: Preview#Singleplayer at Camera Position|Preview from camera position]]

|colorF = PaleGreen
|colorS = PaleGreen
|colorV = PaleGreen
|colorEnter = PaleGreen
|colorNumEnter = PaleGreen

}}
